_sobre: Textos em inglês (en_us.json) do que vem de docs/dados: nomes dos itens, os textos do capítulo Itens do Guia (guia) e a experiência de cada personagem (por número). tools/gerar_conteudo.py exige o texto em inglês de tudo que já entrou no mod; o resto entra junto com a versão.

itens.cristal_superman: Crystal of the House of El

1.exp: Absolute strength and power: you are the strongest person in the world, and the world must be handled with care.

2.exp: Preparation, gear and strategy: you win because you planned, not because you are stronger.

bloco_kryptonita.desc: Nine shards packed together. Its aura weakens Kryptonians within 10 blocks: a good base defense in multiplayer.

camara_solar.desc: Focuses sunlight into a crystal. Kryptonians within 6 blocks recharge as if under the sun, even at night or underground.

cristal_kryptoniano.desc: A crystal from Krypton that came inside the meteor. Ingredient of the Crystal of the House of El and the Solar Chamber.
cristal_kryptoniano.obter: One per Meteor Crater, in the chest hidden inside the meteor at the bottom of the crater.

cristal_superman.desc: Right-click to put on Superman's suit and gain his powers. Press H to turn back to normal.

fragmento_alienigena.desc: A piece of the meteor veined with energy. Used to craft another Hero's Guide and, in future versions, alien technology.
fragmento_alienigena.obter: In the meteor chest at the bottom of Meteor Craters (2 to 4 per chest).

fragmento_kryptonita.desc: A shard of kryptonite. Carrying one drains Superman's energy, gives Weakness and removes super strength.
fragmento_kryptonita.obter: Mine Kryptonite Ore (Fortune increases the amount) or break a Block of Kryptonite back into 9.

guia_heroi.desc: This book. Right-click it or press G to open the tasks, the characters and every mod item with its recipe.
guia_heroi.obter: Every player gets one when joining the world for the first time.

minerio_kryptonita.desc: Green alien rock that glows in the dark. A transformed Superman loses energy and super strength within 6 blocks of it.
minerio_kryptonita.obter: Underground from Y -60 to 0, and exposed in Meteor Craters. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better; Silk Touch drops the ore itself.

nucleo_meta_1.desc: An energy core that awakens powers. Tier I: base of early-game transformation items and of Core II.

nucleo_meta_2.desc: Tier II, with diamond and glowstone dust: base of tier 2 transformation items and of Core III.

nucleo_meta_3.desc: Tier III, with blaze rod, ender pearl and amethyst: base of tier 3 transformation items and of Core IV.

nucleo_meta_4.desc: Tier IV, the strongest, with netherite and echo from the Ancient City: base of end-game transformation items such as Superman's. Does not burn in lava.

tecido_tatico.desc: Tough fabric with a kevlar weave. The base of every hero suit.

cinto_batman.desc: Right-click to put on Batman's suit and carry his gadgets. Press H to turn back to normal.
